description: The image displays two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating the inference time for different methods applied to two models, titled "Marco-o1-7B" on the left and "QwQ-32B-Preview" on the right. The vertical axis for both charts is labeled "Inference Time (minute)" and serves as the category axis, where the categories are represented by color-coded bars rather than explicit text labels on the axis itself. The horizontal axes represent the numerical values on a linear scale; the left chart's axis ranges from 0 to 2.5 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, while the right chart's axis ranges from 0 to 7 with tick marks at intervals of 1. Each chart contains a single group of five horizontal bars arranged from top to bottom. A legend at the bottom identifies the categories by color: Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (grey), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue), noting that the text for the blue category is obscured by a grey rectangle under the left chart but clearly labeled under the right chart. In the "Marco-o1-7B" chart, the longest bar is the Baseline at approximately 2.15 minutes, followed by Fast-Solving Prompt and SFT at roughly 2.1 minutes, DPO at 1.45 minutes, and the shortest bar, O1-Pruner, at approximately 1.1 minutes. In the "QwQ-32B-Preview" chart, the Baseline is again the longest at approximately 6.1 minutes, followed by SFT at 5.85 minutes, DPO at 5.6 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt at 5.0 minutes, and the shortest bar, O1-Pruner, at 4.0 minutes. The bars are ordered consistently across both charts based on the legend sequence rather than being strictly sorted by length, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines or bolding.
